item.title: Xinan Home Recalls WinxMatrs Mattresses Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standard for Mattress Flammability
item.company: Sold Online At: Amazon.com from August 2025 through November 2025 for about $120.
item.brand: Sold Online At: Amazon.com from August 2025 through November 2025 for about $120.
item.summary: This recall involves WinxMatrs-branded mattresses. The black mattresses are 10 inches thick and were sold in a twin size. They were sold compressed in a box. The size and the brand are printed on the mattress’ sewn-in labels.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled mattresses immediately and contact Xinan Home for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to destroy the mattress by writing in permanent marker “RECALLED,” on the top surface of the mattress and on the mattress label and send photos of the marked mattress and of the label showing Xinan Home to WinxMatrsMattressRecall@outlook.com.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
